skill1: Incoming healing ▲ 4% continuously, stacks up to 5 time(s).
Activates after landing 100 normal attack(s). Affects all Electric Code allies. Stack count of buffs ▲ 1.
skill2: Activates when the HP of one of the allies on both sides is lower than 90%. Affects all allies. Generates a Shield with 10.22% of the skill user's final Max HP for 10 sec.
Activates when the HP of one of the allies on both sides reaches Max HP. Affects all allies. True Damage ▲ 30.97% for 5 sec.

caveats: ⚑ S1 continuous HoT duration/tick count is undefined; modeled as one recovery event.
⚑ S1 incoming-healing stack system and its 100-hit advancement are unmodeled (no matching StatKey/effect).
⚑ S2 HP-threshold triggers are unsupported by engine triggers; shield/true-damage lines are unmodeled.
⚑ MG cadence for the 100-hit trigger is not derivable from kit text.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Flora S1: continuous HoT modeled as a single recovery event because the kit gives no duration/fight length; incoming-healing stack system and its 100-hit advancement are unmodeled (no StatKey). S2: ally-HP threshold triggers (<90% and reaches Max HP) are unsupported by the engine's trigger vocabulary, so the shield and true-damage buff lines are recorded in unmodeled. Burst: one-time HP recovery plus a trueDamagePct buff on own burst cast. No weapon-swap, no piercing, no kit noFb data; range/noFb left to engine defaults.
